contextual_fit.dialogue_purpose_excludes: Any statutory, licensing, PPE, storage, SDS, spraying, notification or reporting obligation.

alya.reasoning: The same shape she already plays in the approved B02 S02, where she asks what remains after planting work. T04 opens on exactly that hinge. She asks; she does not assert.

encik_rahman.role_in_dialogue: EXPLAINER — names the process and the two categories
encik_rahman.conditional_on: the dialogue staying at process-overview level
encik_rahman.reasoning: Naming six supervisory activities and distinguishing soft from hard landscape is ordinary senior-contractor knowledge and is the register he uses in the approved B02 S02. None of it requires a credential.

contextual_fit.specialist_expertise_detail: The unit contains regulated content — pesticide use under statute, a licensed-operator requirement, SDS handling and spray-drift control. That material needs a licensed operator's competence. Slide 2 does not touch it, and the screens that do carry it as source quotation on T04-S14/S15/S16 rather than as anyone's speech.

unsupported_expertise_risk.description: If Slide 2 were extended into the Racun material, Encik Rahman would be voicing statutory and licensing obligations no source attributes to him. The source itself says the person who sprays must be a licensed operator — a competence the character bank does not give him.
unsupported_expertise_risk.mitigation: Slide 2 is bound to seven process-and-category rows and nothing else. A gate scans every dialogue line for the source's own compliance vocabulary and fails on a hit.

contextual_fit.recommendation_condition: For SLIDE 2 ONLY, with the dialogue scoped to the process overview and the two landscape categories. This is not a finding that the pair suits the whole unit.
contextual_fit.new_character_would_be_required_if: Bariah wants the dialogue to carry pesticide licensing, PPE or spray-safety content — in which case the honest move is a licensed-operator character.

dialogue.compliance_exclusion_rule: No dialogue line may state a legal, licensing, PPE, storage, SDS, spraying, notification or reporting obligation. Those live on T04-S14, T04-S15 and T04-S16 as source quotation.

lines.speaker: Alya
lines.text: Encik Rahman, kerja pembinaan dan tanaman di tapak ini dah siap. Selepas ini apa yang perlu diuruskan?
lines.instructional_function: Opens the hinge the module itself opens on — what follows construction.
lines.factual_risk_status: LOW — restates the framing of T04-ROW-002

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.text: Sekarang masuk fasa penjagaan dan penyelenggaraan. Ada enam aktiviti penyeliaan yang perlu berjalan, daripada koordinasi kerja sampailah kepada perancangan sumber manusia.
lines.instructional_function: Names the phase and its six-activity flow, previewing T04-S03.
lines.factual_risk_status: LOW — the six activities and their order are measured from T04-DGM-01

lines.speaker: Alya
lines.text: Semua elemen di tapak diselenggara sama caranya?
lines.instructional_function: Sets up the soft/hard distinction as a learner question.

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.text: Tidak. Landskap lembut itu elemen hidup — pokok, rumput, tanaman. Landskap kejur pula elemen binaan yang kekal. Keperluan penyelenggaraannya berbeza.
lines.instructional_function: Draws the organising contrast of the whole unit.
lines.factual_risk_status: LOW — both definitions are compressions of their source rows

lines.speaker: Alya
lines.text: Jadi saya kena faham keperluan kedua-duanya sebelum susun jadual penyelenggaraan.
lines.instructional_function: Closes on the learner's own next step, mirroring the approved B02 S02 closing move.

dialogue.length_note: Five turns, one learner screen. The approved B02 S02 dialogue is also five turns.
dialogue.drafting_basis: Bariah ruled that Slide 2 takes a dialogue scenario (BR-C3). The lines are CAIR_ASSISTED_DRAFT on the same footing as the Rumusan — proposed, not approved, and hers to rewrite.
